risks.risk: Model mismatch (seller says PSR-650 but photo label looks like PSR-550), which affects value and parts/compatibility.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model label/serial plate (or the exact model text) and the back panel.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lower/uncertain model shown in the photo (PSR-550) and treat any mismatch as reducing resale value.

risks.risk: Not actually working (keys, speakers, power supply, display, and sound output not tested in the photo).
risks.proof: Short video clip: power on, display lights up, play a few notes, and show volume/speaker output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified/assume worst case: needs testing or may have faults (i.e., not guaranteed working).

risks.risk: Cosmetic wear/damage (visible dust/scuffs; could indicate heavier internal wear).
risks.proof: More photos: close-ups of the keyboard keybed (any missing/loose keys), control knobs/buttons, and speaker area.
risks.if_unproven: Price with a deduction for visible wear and potential minor damage.

risks.proof: Photo of everything included: power adapter/cord, sustain pedal, and any manuals/stand.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming only the unit is included (no accessories), or that missing items reduce usability.

proof_requests: Send a video: power on + screen working + play keys + confirm speaker output (volume up/down).
Send a clear close-up of the model label/serial plate (front and back) to confirm PSR-550 vs PSR-650.
Send photos of the power adapter/cord and any pedals included.
Send close-ups of the keyboard keys (especially corners) and the control buttons/knobs for damage or missing parts.
response.reason: The photo suggests the model is PSR-550 (not PSR-650), and the 'working perfectly' claim is not verifiable from a single non-powered photo. Proof via power-on and audio test is needed before pricing confidently.
